title: Seeded Roll
prompt: Seed the random generator with 42, then print random.randint(1, 10). The value is deterministic — tests know it.

tests.name: deterministic output
tests.code:
assert printed[0] == "2", f"seed 42 gives 2, got {printed}"
assert "seed(42)" in code, "seed with 42"
assert "import random" in code, "import random"
